title: Photo Video Gallery Locker
summary: Lock & hide images, videos & gallery password protection with encryption.
description:
Photo Video Locker – Keep Your Private Media Safe & Hidden! 🔐📸🎥
Safeguard your most personal photos, videos, and files with Photo Video Locker, the ultimate privacy app for Android. Designed with advanced encryption and security features, your private content stays protected—only you can access it.

🔑 Why Photo Video Locker?
🔐 Secure Vault: Hide and encrypt photos, videos & sensitive files.
🔑 Multi-Layered Security: PIN, pattern, fingerprint, fake passcodes, and intruder selfies.
🎭 Disguised Mode: Camouflage app with a hidden launcher and decoy vault.
🗃️ Custom Albums: Organize media into folders & subfolders—even on SD cards.
🗑️ Trash Recovery: Deleted media goes to trash first—recover within 30 days.
☁️ Cloud Backup: Sync securely with Dropbox for recovery after reinstall or device loss.
🌐 Privacy Browser & Downloader: Browse privately and download encrypted videos.
🎨 Custom Themes: Light & dark mode to suit your preference.

🛡️ Key Features
Advanced Encryption – Keeps media files hidden from other apps and file explorers.
Hidden Vault – Locked behind your chosen authentication method.
Intruder Alerts – Captures a photo if someone enters the wrong password.
Fake Login – Use a decoy password to access a fake vault.
Smart Import – Import from gallery, camera, or web with ease.
Private Web Surfing – No browsing history is saved.

📱 Optimized for Android Devices
Built for speed, reliability, and maximum compatibility across Android smartphones and tablets.

Download Photo Video Locker now and protect your most private memories with confidence! 🚀🔐
recentChanges: This update ensures full compatibility with the latest Android versions while addressing minor bugs to deliver a smoother and more reliable user experience
